Making your own

Every line here comes from the divider editor in InstaStylr, where you can change the character, the length and the ornament in the middle, and see it in your caption as you go. The dividers tutorial walks through it.

Long dividers can wrap onto a second line on narrow phones. Around 10 to 15 characters is safe for Instagram.
